title: Crop and Resize floor their longest edge at 2048 instead of inheriting Make GIF's 1024
description: Fabio, 2026-09-20, straight out of MPI-844: a 9:16 crop of full-res 1080x1920 frames built a 576x1024 .gif. The Block posts the CURRENT entry's output with every transform, so a crop inherits its cap, and Make GIF stamps maxEdge 1024 — raising the route's own fallback would have been a no-op. gifTransform now floors the cap at 2048 (a floor, not a replacement: an entry allowing more keeps its value). The frames in the store were always full-res; only the build ceiling was throwing pixels away.
